newsitem.title: MEXICO: EPN seeks to delist shrs on Mexico bolsa.
newsitem.headline: EPN seeks to delist shrs on Mexico bolsa.

text.p: Mexican chemicals company EPN SA will ask to be delisted either permanently or temporarily from the Mexican bourse due to its weak share price, the firm said on Tuesday.
"In case it is not possible to cancel (the listing), we will ask for the temporary suspension of the listing of our shares...," the company said in a statement to the Mexican Stock Exchange (Bolsa).
The company will propose the move to its shareholders at a meeting June 29, it said.
In the past few weeks, the company's A1 shares have tumbled from 0.05 peso per share to 0.015 peso per share. The company has several series of stock and will try to delist all.
The company gave no reason for the weak trade of its stock, though traders said rumors that the company would try to delist probably aggravated the stock's poor performance.
